0.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_000
0.description: On behalf of the Resistance, I thank you again for lending your strength to our cause. Reforging the blades of Gunnhildr is certain to stir the fire in our men's hearts.

1.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_001
1.description: When the battle begins in earnest, I should hope we can count on your continued assistance.

2.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_002
2.description: Now then, is there aught you wish to discuss?

3.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_010
3.description: Our efforts to retake the castrum proceed apace. When you have a spare moment, I would introduce you to the new Gunnhildr's Blades. They await us at Utya's Aegis.

4.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_011
4.description: Is there anything you wish to discuss before leaving?

5.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_020
5.description: Mikoto requested you speak with her as soon as possible. Something to do with the crystal focus, I believe.

6.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_021
6.description: I will not keep you. Unless, of course, there is something you wished to discuss?

7.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_025
7.description: Operation Eagle's Nest is now underway. I daresay there is not a soldier among us who would not lay down their life to see our plans realized. I would never ask such a sacrifice of you, but we would be honored to have you fighting at our side.

8.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_026
8.description: Now, if there is nothing else you wish to discuss, I will not keep you.

9.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_030
9.description: Would that we had the resources or manpower to investigate the reasons for Misija's treachery, but for now we must focus our efforts on taking the castrum.

10.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_031
10.description: I will not keep you. Unless, of course, there is something else you wish to discuss?

13.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_040
13.description: There will be ample time to reflect on our defeat later. First we must return to Gangos at once and regroup.

14.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_045
14.description: Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine Queen Gunnhildr herself could be turned against us, her blades enslaved by way of foul magicks.

15.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_046
15.description: Now that I think of it, reforging the blades of Gunnhildr was originally proposed by Misija, as was the exploration of memories. Could this have been her aim all along?

16.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_047
16.description: At any rate, something must be done about this new weapon of the Empire.

17.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_048
17.description: If you've nothing else to discuss, I would give this new turn of events some thought.

18.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_050
18.description: Should the queen be summoned again, I cannot risk more soldiers falling prey to her influence. Please, you must find Mikoto.

19.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_051
19.description: Is there anything you wished to discuss before you go?

20.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_055
20.description: After careful instruction from Mikoto, our soldiers are ready to depart. When you are ready, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, we will make for the ruins.

21.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_060
21.description: The imperial reinforcements we have dreaded for so long have arrived at last, though it remains to be seen why they yet refuse to strike.

22.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_061
22.description: If it is true that the IVth Legion has cut ties with Garlemald, this will quite likely be their last attempt to drive us out.

23.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_062
23.description: Failure is not an option. We must ready our defenses, and petition our Far Eastern allies for additional aid if possible. I have no doubt our next battle will decide the fate of Bozja.

24.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_063
24.description: I will leave you to your preparations, unless there is something you wish to discuss?

25.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_070
25.description: A great many of our troops have already left for Zadnor, and I intend to join them ere long. I hope to see you there as well, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>.

26.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_075
26.description: Lilja has been asking after you, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. I believe she wished to discuss another survey of the land with you.

27.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_076
27.description: If you have naught else to discuss with me, I will not keep you.

28.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_080
28.description: So long as the IVth Legion controls the skies, it will be no easy task to advance on their position. That said, I am quite confident Cid's plan will offer us the protection we need to push the front line forward.

29.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_081
29.description: ...Is there something you wished to discuss? If not, I will leave you to your duties.

30.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_085
30.description: Cid's plan has proven a resounding success. The IVth Legion will no doubt redouble their efforts to deny our advance, but I imagine it will not be long before we are prepared to secure yet another outpost.

31.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_086
31.description: ...Is there something you wished to discuss? If not, I will leave you to your duties.

32.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_090
32.description: The <hex:021A020203>Dalriada<hex:021A020103> must be brought down before the IVth Legion can unleash this Allagan weapon of theirs. I pray this latest invention of Cid's works...

33.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_095
33.description: I know not what Menenius has unearthed in the ruins, but I would rather not afford him time to employ it.

34.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_096
34.description: Let us be swift, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, and put an end to him and the IVth Legion.

35.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_100
35.description: At long last, we have done it. Bozja, our home, is free from the IVth Legion. I have not the words to tell you how thankful I am for everything you have done.

36.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_101
36.description: Were it possible, I would ask that you remain here in Bozja to assist in our efforts to rebuild, though I understand full well the infeasibility of such a request.

37.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_102
37.description: The path before us now is a long one, but it is one that shall be paved with peace and prosperity for all.

38.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_000_103
38.description: If there is nothing else, I must return to my duties.

40.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_A10_000_000
40.description: Tell me about Bozja and the Resistance.

42.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_A10_000_002
42.description: Tell me about the Bozja incident.

43.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_A10_100_002
43.description: Tell me about the new Gunnhildr's Blades.

49.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_A20_000_002
49.description: What will become of Bozja now?

52.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_200
52.description: Our home rests in the southern reaches of Ilsabard, to the west of Dalmasca.

53.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_201
53.description: Our earliest records─or at least those we have been able to recover─suggest Bozja was founded at some point during the Third Astral Era. The Allagan Empire had reached the height of its power, and several tribes of the Hrothgar came here seeking refuge from their supremacy.

54.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_202
54.description: It was Queen Gunnhildr who would keep the Allagans at bay. Her radiance would light our path to prosperity, and by her grace was the nation of Bozja founded.

55.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_203
55.description: Alas, the Fourth Umbral Calamity would see the end of her kingdom. But those who survived slowly rebuilt, and Bozja was reborn as a city-state that would coexist with neighboring nations for centuries to come.

56.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_204
56.description: The Garlean Empire's rise to power changed everything. None could oppose the sheer strength and versatility of their military.

57.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_205
57.description: Their campaign began some fifty years ago, and now an entire generation of our people has been raised knowing only oppression. But now they would know freedom.

58.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_206
58.description: When word reached us that Ala Mhigo and Doma had risen up to defy the Empire, we seized the opportunity to flee and form pockets of resistance.

59.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_207
59.description: With Lord Hien's assistance, the several groups that had formed were merged into a single, cohesive force, and I was chosen as its leader.

60.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_208
60.description: If the IVth Imperial Legion is able to consolidate its forces in Bozja, however, our efforts will be for naught. We have to strike back, and soon.

61.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_210
61.description: But now the time has come to fight back. The several groups that had formed have now merged into a single, cohesive force, and thanks to your efforts, the blades of Gunnhildr are now at our disposal.

62.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_211
62.description: What's more, we have reclaimed Utya's Aegis. If we strike before the IVth Legion can request reinforcements, we may very well succeed in taking Castrum Lacus Litore as well.

63.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_220
63.description: But now the time has come to fight back. The several groups that had formed have now merged into a single, cohesive force, and thanks to your efforts, Gunnhildr's Blades have been born anew.

64.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_225
64.description: We have come a long way in our fight against the imperials, thanks in no small part to your efforts. Why, without your timely assistance, the revival of Gunnhildr's Blades would have been little more than a dream.

65.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_226
65.description: And with our forces consolidated, we were able to force back the IVth Legion, affording us the opportunity to seize Castrum Lacus Litore.

66.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_227
66.description: Alas, no one could foresee the summoning of Queen Gunnhildr... But having come thus far, we cannot give in to despair. To do so would be a dishonor to the brave soldiers who laid down their lives for the future of Bozja.

67.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_230
67.description: I can only pray our efforts thus far will be enough. Though Queen Gunnhildr no longer poses a threat, we will be hard-pressed to overcome the imperials' reinforcements. But we mustn't give in to despair. To do so would be a dishonor to those who laid down their lives for the future of Bozja.

68.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_300
68.description: For the present, this is our base of operations, to the southeast of what remains of Bozja Citadel. When the fighting begins, we will hold the line here.

69.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_301
69.description: For a blessing, the surrounding wetlands and the fog that persists year-round have served to conceal our operation. That is not to say, of course, we have not taken additional measures to remain hidden.

70.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_302
70.description: In the unlikely event that their scouts should approach the perimeter, our mages have cast a cloaking spell around the area to keep us from sight.

71.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_303
71.description: Havens such as this are plentiful along the southern coast of Ilsabard. Our facilities are rather modest, I confess, but I would like to think we have made great strides in providing for our soldiers here.

72.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_304
72.description: Thanks to the generosity of our allies here in the East, as well as the Eorzean Alliance, we do not want for provisions or arms. All that remains is to secure the blades of Gunnhildr.

73.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_305
73.description: In the unlikely event that their scouts should approach the perimeter, our mages have cast a cloaking spell around the area to keep us from sight.

74.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_306
74.description: Havens such as this are plentiful along the southern coast of Ilsabard. Our facilities are rather modest, I confess, but I would like to think we have made great strides in providing for our soldiers here.

75.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_400
75.description: It was roughly twenty years ago, if I'm not mistaken. The Empire, fearful of the threat posed by primals and the tribes who summoned them, devised a plan to wipe them out.

76.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_401
76.description: The Meteor project. Through the use of magitek, they intended to recreate ancient sorcery capable of calling down meteors.

77.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_402
77.description: At the helm of the project was their chief engineer, Midas nan Garlond. In time, every last one of their research facilities was involved in its development.

78.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_403
78.description: The project would take a perilous turn when it was discovered that the lesser moon Dalamud was, in fact, a satellite of Allagan design. They were determined to make it part of their plans.

79.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_404
79.description: And so they erected a colossal transmission tower, designed to control Dalamud. Its first test would also prove to be its last...

80.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_405
80.description: For lack of eyewitnesses, what happened next is difficult to describe. It is often described as an explosion, but the ruins showed no signs of gunpowder or magic. We only know that a terrible light shone from the heavens that night.

81.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_406
81.description: In an instant, the citadel was gone. Its citizens and soldiers...my family...

82.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_407
82.description: No one is certain why Dalamud responded with such destructive force, but all work on the Meteor project was halted immediately.

83.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_101_407
83.description: It is a terrifying thought that Bahamut is the reason Dalamud responded with such destructive force, but needless to say, all work on the Meteor project was halted immediately.

84.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_408
84.description: Five years later, however, Nael van Darnus set the wheels of the project back into motion. His devotion was rewarded with the coming of the Seventh Umbral Calamity.

85.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_409
85.description: The world has already paid too great a cost for the Garleans' ambition... They must be stopped.

86.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_430
86.description: As you know, Queen Gunnhildr was protected by an elite guard known as Gunnhildr's Blades. Their title would one day lend itself to the most renowned of their weaponry─the gunblade, but each of her guard was said to have mastered a unique weapon.

87.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_431
87.description: These blades were said to be blessed by the gods, and in the unlikely event one of the queen's guard should fall in battle, their weapon was passed on to a suitable successor.

88.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_432
88.description: When Lord Hien suggested we find a symbol our people might rally behind, we were admittedly at a loss. For lack of a living figurehead, we looked to the past, and there we found our answer─the blades of Gunnhildr.

89.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_433
89.description: It was a simple solution, in principle, but without your help, and that of Mikoto and Master Gerolt, we never could have succeeded. I believe I speak for all of us when I say we are eternally grateful for what you have done.

90.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_434
90.description: With the weapons of Queen Gunnhildr forged anew, we then bestowed them upon our finest soldiers. Indeed, the illustrious Gunnhildr's Blades have been reborn.

91.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_435
91.description: They have each been assigned to the head of a unit, and soldier morale has never been higher. It is exactly as Lord Hien predicted.

92.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_436
92.description: Of course, they have also found a source of inspiration in you, Blade <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>. Though our martial prowess is not a match for yours, what we lack in strength, we make up for with courage. Even if it should cost our lives, Bozja will be free.

93.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_440
93.description: I was so certain our plan would succeed... But who could have foreseen Queen Gunnhildr herself being turned against us? Our soldiers, Gunnhildr's Blades, made her slaves.

94.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_441
94.description: We must find a way to save them, and free the queen from whatever magicks bind her to the Empire. Otherwise, I fear Bozja may forever remain beyond our grasp.

95.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_445
95.description: I was so certain our plan would succeed... But who could have foreseen Queen Gunnhildr herself being turned against us? Gunnhildr's Blades, our greatest weapon in the battle for Bozja, now fighting for the IVth Legion.

96.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_446
96.description: If no remedy can be found to free them from her control, then I fear death will be the only release we can offer them.

97.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_450
97.description: I was so certain our plan would succeed... But who could have foreseen Queen Gunnhildr herself being turned against us? Being forced to cut down Gunnhildr's Blades.

98.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_451
98.description: It was indeed a heavy blow to morale, but I know they would not want us to mourn their passing. As was tradition in the days of old, we must find capable soldiers to carry on in their stead, and press onward. Come what may, Bozja will be freed from the Empire.

99.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_500
99.description: I was born in Bozja, though I have never known a life free from the Empire's rule.

100.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_501
100.description: Following in my late father's footsteps, I studied to become a doctor. Much to my surprise, and dismay, my academic accomplishments did not go unnoticed. I was taken to the capital, where I received a formal education in medicinal sciences. Deployment as a medic in their military soon followed.

101.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_502
101.description: My service was ultimately rewarded with citizenship, after which I met my wife, and we started a family together. If their goal was for me to grow content and complacent, it failed, for not a day went by that I did not think about the liberation of my homeland.

102.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_503
102.description: But I would need to bide my time a while longer, for I was assigned to the IVth Imperial Legion. There was an uprising in Nagxia, and it fell to us to quell their insurrection. It was not until after our mission was complete that I learned of what happened to Bozja. To my family...

103.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_504
103.description: We returned as fast as we were able, but there was nothing left of the citadel.

104.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_505
104.description: I was ordered to return to the capital, but I had to find my wife and children. I covered every ilm of that barren wasteland...and nothing.

105.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_506
105.description: Chains and a prison cell greeted me back in Garlemald, but in spite of my confinement, whispers of what happened in Bozja eventually reached me. Of their failed experiments to control Dalamud.

106.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_507
106.description: Stripped of my citizenship, I expected to remain under lock and key until the end of my days. Fortunately for me, they had need of more medics for their next campaign.

107.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_508
107.description: But I would never reach the battlefield, for I escaped with a number of other soldiers to join the Resistance.

108.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_BAISHAEN_100_509
108.description: Many years of service to the Resistance then molded me into the man who now stands before you. And I will continue to serve for as long as it takes to see our homeland safe from the Empire.

109.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_600
109.description: Zadnor, yes. The “sinking plateau” in our mother tongue. It lies to the northeast of the southern front, not far from the territories of Dalmasca.

110.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_601
110.description: A gentle rolling plain, once upon a time. Until the Fourth Umbral Calamity, that is. The great quake would mold the landscape into the various flat-topped mountains we know now as Zadnor.

111.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_602
111.description: The land was also enriched with a vast store of earth-aspected crystals. When first discovered, miners and prospectors wasted no time in establishing a bustling mining industry.

112.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_603
112.description: Unfortunately those reserves of earth crystals would not last. The mines ran dry some hundred years ago. All that remains now is barren wasteland.

113.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_604
113.description: It is worth noting, however, the floating rock formations are not a result of the Calamity, but the Bozja incident. The energies that wiped the citadel off the map were absorbed into the ground, causing portions of it to rise up into the sky.

114.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_605
114.description: What's more, this upheaval of the land has exposed a number of Allagan ruins. The gods only know what the IVth Legion intends to find within them.

115.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_610
115.description: It is worth noting, however, the floating rock formations are not a result of the Calamity, but the Bozja incident. The energies that wiped the citadel off the map were absorbed into the ground, causing portions of it to rise up into the sky.

116.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_611
116.description: What's more, this upheaval of the land has exposed a number of Allagan ruins. Never did I imagine such horrors would be found within them.

117.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_700
117.description: Vrdelnis was originally a small settlement founded by miners come to seek their fortune. Who would have thought it might also serve as shelter in our search for freedom?

118.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_701
118.description: It was so named for the flowers that once bloomed in abundance in these lands. Sadly, they would never grow again after the Bozja incident.

119.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_702
119.description: The energies that permeated the land in the wake of Bahamut's assault on the citadel irrevocably altered the land's aether currents, resulting in a nigh-uninhabitable environment.

120.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_703
120.description: We chose this location to make use of the aether current that flows below it, but it is─as Lilja might put it─sporadic at best. It has served our purposes well enough for now, but I suspect securing additional outposts closer to the enemy will prove difficult.

121.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_704
121.description: Without sufficient stores of ambient aether in the ground, we cannot erect an aetheryte, nor can we protect the surrounding area with one of Cid's barriers.

122.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_705
122.description: Thankfully, Lilja has fashioned a device to remedy this problem, allowing us to reroute nearby aether currents to suit our purposes.

123.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_710
123.description: Vrdelnis was originally a small settlement founded by miners come to seek their fortune. Who would have thought it might also serve as shelter in our search for freedom?

124.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_711
124.description: It was so named for the flowers that once bloomed in abundance there. Sadly, they would never grow again after the Bozja incident.

125.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_712
125.description: The energies that permeated the land in the wake of Bahamut's assault on the citadel irrevocably altered the land's aether currents, resulting in a nigh-uninhabitable environment.

126.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_713
126.description: We chose the location to make use of the aether current that flows below it, but it was─as Lilja might put it─sporadic at best. It served our purposes well enough at the time, but it proved difficult securing additional outposts closer to the enemy.

127.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_714
127.description: Without sufficient stores of ambient aether in the ground, we would have been unable to erect an aetheryte, nor would we have been able to protect the surrounding area with one of Cid's barriers.

128.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_715
128.description: Thankfully, Lilja fashioned a device to remedy this problem, allowing us to reroute nearby aether currents to suit our purposes.

129.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_801
129.description: The battle for Bozja is over, but our work is far from finished. Indeed, one might say the true battle begins now, as the various factions of the Resistance seek to fulfill their individual agendas.

130.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_802
130.description: Which is why I wish to first create a council of their leaders that we might discuss and establish laws to govern all of our people.

131.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_803
131.description: I have already begun drafting documents that may one day serve as our constitution, though it remains to be seen if they will meet with the others' approval.

132.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_804
132.description: You see, I have chosen to base a number of my writings on the principles of the IVth Legion.

133.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_805
133.description: Many would argue it is a misguided plan, but I have no intention of doing this in secret. The peoples' trust requires honesty, and I have no intention of repeating the mistakes of our forebears.

134.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_806
134.description: A great many of us did not hesitate to join the Resistance, some even giving their lives for our cause, but we mustn't forget there were those who chose to remain in the imperial provinces. And though it was a singular instance, Misija was persuaded to join the IVth Legion despite pledging herself to our cause. I cannot help but consider Gabranth's point of view. The philosophy behind his leadership.

135.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_807
135.description: To discard everything that came as a result of the occupation would cause more harm than good. There are many things introduced by the imperials from which we stand to benefit, and it would be foolish to dismiss them simply because they came from the enemy.

136.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_808
136.description: Make no mistake─the Bozja I intend to build will be free of discrimination and poverty. A nation of the people, by the people, and for the people. As such, it will require the understanding and cooperation of all.

137.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_809
137.description: A great deal of blood has been shed that we might come this far, and I pray we never forget, that we may never again have to endure such tragedy.

138.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_810
138.description: Once a constitution has been ratified and the foundations of our governing body are in place, we will hold an election, that the people may choose officials they believe best represent their ideals.

139.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_811
139.description: If all goes to plan, the first of many elections will be held within the next two years. When next you visit Bozja, I should think you will be proud to see the nation we have become.

140.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_900
140.description: Rostik? He left without so much as a good-bye. Pity, that. I wished for him to stay and help in the rebuilding of Bozja.

141.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_901
141.description: Before joining the Resistance, he was something of a lone wolf, bent on avenging those he lost at the hands of the Empire.

142.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_902
142.description: I'd like to think he's changed since fighting alongside us, if only just. When last I saw him, he seemed keen to fight for more than just his own self-satisfaction.

143.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_903
143.description: Bozja has need of men like him. People who truly understand the pain of loss, possessed of empathy and compassion. People who will labor to ensure others will not have to endure such suffering.

144.name: TEXT_REGOTH4MYCBAICHAOUEN_00657_100_904
144.description: To implore him to stay would no doubt have only expedited his plans to leave. Even so, I should like to think he will not stay away for long.
